units: USD millions and million shares; prices USD per share
scope: Standalone Rocket Lab; pending Iridium operations, consideration, bridge borrowing and issuance excluded together. Accrued existing financing fee remains a claim.

sources.note_locator: Note 11: 4.25% coupon, February/August payments, February 1 2029 maturity; Note 6: June fair value
sources.forward_locator: Note 12: collared forward, 7,451,200 shares, April 2028 expected proceeds 474-642 million; no H1 receipts
sources.capped_call_locator: MD&A liquidity: tranches December 1 2028-January 30 2029, maximum aggregate payoff approximately 201.9 million

challenge_record.value: Integrated scenario cutoff cash + securities - 200 reserve
challenge_record.basis: Use matching three-statements output; reserve is an analyst operating-cash allowance.
challenge_record.challenge: Cutoff balance is interpolated, not reported; reserve is not independently established.
challenge_record.change_evidence: Dated cash/settlement disclosures and operating liquidity requirements. Stress reserve 100 and 300.

challenge_record.value: Zero reference recovery; 32.15 book-value recovery sensitivity
challenge_record.basis: Separate financial receivable; its interest is excluded from FCFF. Zero is a conservative haircut, not evidence of impairment.
challenge_record.challenge: Recoverable present value is not established; book value may understate/overstate it.
challenge_record.change_evidence: Loan maturity, credit support, payment history and market yield.

challenge_record.value: Explicit historical June fair value, September-price parity, and separate intrinsic-only diagnostic
challenge_record.basis: Remove conversion shares whenever an economic note claim is deducted. Straight-debt floor discounts remaining coupons/principal at assumed 6%.
challenge_record.challenge: Neither stale fair value nor parity is a current quote. Intrinsic-only diagnostic omits option time value, make-whole adjustments, credit and detailed settlement terms; it is not a fair-value estimate.
challenge_record.change_evidence: Cutoff note quote, conversion/settlement records, full instrument pricing and dated credit inputs.

challenge_record.value: All existing RSUs vest; options tested at remaining weighted-average strike 1.09
challenge_record.basis: Known September exercise already in cash/common; only remaining options generate additional receipts. Exercise receipts assumed immediate for the valuation allocation.
challenge_record.challenge: Weighted-average strike conceals individual awards; award time value and vesting are not fully priced. Full exercise and no exercise are alternatives, never combined.
challenge_record.change_evidence: Award-level vesting, strike and expiry schedules; actual settlements. Future compensation remains an economic cost in FCFF.

challenge_record.value: 474/642 future cash with 7.4512 new shares; midpoint-date proxy April 30 2028
challenge_record.basis: Present-value future cash at 16%, count full future share participation now; reference omission explicitly separate.
challenge_record.challenge: Exact contract tranches, settlement election, proceeds adjustments and fees not verified. Do not discount share count or assume H1 receipt.
challenge_record.change_evidence: Contract terms and dated settlement confirmations. No implication these sensitivities exhaust contract fair value.

challenge_record.value: Zero reference; discounted maximum 201.9 payoff scenario
challenge_record.basis: Use final tranche date conservatively for timing, no additional shares. Not a probability-weighted asset valuation.
challenge_record.challenge: Payoff depends on future stock prices across tranches; maximum is not assured and may be implausible in the weak business case.
challenge_record.change_evidence: Actual contract valuation, hedge/settlement notices and tranche-specific forward prices.

challenge_record.value: Paired hypothetical gross cash/share issuance at 61.96 or 30.98, 2% fees
challenge_record.basis: Disclosed authorization, not verified completed cutoff sales. Treat as immediate hypothetical financing with no operating acquisition.
challenge_record.challenge: Raising at the historical quote could transfer value from new investors if above modeled value; it is not evidence of intrinsic operating upside. Funds used for acquisitions cannot remain cash while acquired operations are excluded.
challenge_record.change_evidence: Cutoff issued shares/net cash and approved use of proceeds; exclude post-cutoff announcements.
